body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request fixes two CI workflow failures that were blocking the main branch: a regex parse error in the link checker configuration and a high-severity security vulnerability in transitive dependencies.

**Changes:**
- Fixed Check Links workflow by migrating exclusion patterns from `.lycheeignore` (which incorrectly used glob syntax) to `lychee.toml` with proper regex patterns
- Resolved minimatch ReDoS vulnerability (GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26) by adding a pnpm override to force version 10.2.1 across all transitive dependencies
- Updated ROADMAP.md with current codebase metrics (200 schema files, 1,600+ exports, 6,507 tests)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 53 out of 54 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| package.json | Added pnpm.overrides to force minimatch@10.2.1 for security fix |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Updated to resolve all minimatch dependencies to 10.2.1; removed vulnerable versions (3.1.2, 5.1.6, 9.0.5) |
| lychee.toml | Added exclude_path with proper regex patterns for meta.json files |
| .lycheeignore | Removed glob-style file path patterns (moved to lychee.toml) |
| .github/workflows/check-links.yml | Removed redundant --exclude-path CLI arguments (now in config file) |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated codebase metrics to reflect current state (200 schemas, 1,600+ exports, 6,507 tests) |
| content/docs/references/**/*.mdx | Auto-generated documentation updates for new schema additions and migrations (HttpMethod/HttpRequest moved to shared/http, new system schemas for provisioning/training/supplier-security) |
| content/docs/references/**/meta.json | Updated navigation metadata to include new schema documentation pages |
</details>
